Defend Gor'shak.

Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.
Return to Thrall!

Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.  You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.  Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.  You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.  You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.  When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.
Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.  Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

q.t: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
q.ob: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.  The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

q.t: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
q.ob: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

q.t: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
q.ob: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.
Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Slay Nefarian and recover the Red Scepter Shard. Return the Red Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. You have 5 hours to complete this task.
Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one Blasted Boar Lung to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one Blasted Boar Lung to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to Bloodmage Lynnore.
Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to Bloodmage Lynnore.
Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
Speak to Dispatch Commander Ruag in Stonard.

Free nine Servants of Razelikh, three Servants of Sevine, three Servants of Allistarj, and three Servants of Grol. Return to the Fallen Hero when your task is complete. You must remain within close proximity of the stones or the process will fail.
Open the chest and claim your reward.
Speak to Corporal Thund Splithoof.
Find out what became of Lieutenant Kirith.
Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.
Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in Azshara.
Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp.
Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.

Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj.  Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.
Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.
Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.
Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.

q.t: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
q.ob: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.
Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.
Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.  You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.  You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.
Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.
Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.
Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.  Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.
Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.
Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.  You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.
Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.
Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
Defeat 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants, and 8 Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.
Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.
Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.
Take a Scalding Mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar before it gets cold in five minutes!
Return Nori's Mug to Nori Pridedrift.
Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.
